patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 3 removes the prior inferred rotation-command ports/interface/flow. The controller description and synchronization action still state only the patent-supported responsibility: controlling at least two rods so their abutment means have equal rotational position relative to the release edge (f28900d954312c449cce1af7c239ae7c). Storage/delivery, release edge/chute, rods and helical spaces, abutment/separating edge, and optional downstream processing recipient are grounded in the cited patent passages. No command protocol, actuator, sensor, or unsupported upstream source is asserted.

functional_completeness.rationale: The model captures the core disclosed delivery, entry into a separated space, rotational transport, separation of successive bars, and rod synchronization functions. The described control responsibility remains after removal of the unsupported signal interface. Omission of claim geometry details such as the bar-diameter gap and alternative rotational extent does not undermine this model; those are not necessary to represent its core functional flow.

flow_consistency.rationale: Both remaining material flows connect out-to-in ports of matching descriptive material type: storage/delivery to rotating transport, and transport to the downstream recipient. There are no orphaned control flows or mismatched signal connections. The model does not assert a direction relationship that would conflict with disclosed alternatives.

claim_traceability.rationale: The model's ID-bearing elements are accompanied by citation paths in the supplied candidate: model metadata, all subsystems, ports, parts, material flows, interfaces, actions, and action steps. Relevant claim/embodiment support includes claims 1, 3–7, 9, 12, and 13 as represented by the cited passages. No new claim-level obligation or unsupported engineering requirement is introduced.

interfaces.rationale: Each remaining interface is recorded once and references existing ports and flows with compatible material directions/types. The former ROTATION_CONTROL-to-ROTATING_TRANSPORT command-signal interface has been removed. ROTATION_CONTROL still has a patent-grounded descriptive synchronization responsibility and action, without implying an undisclosed interface implementation. The optional processing sink is explicitly disclosed as a possible recipient and separately modeled.

textbook_application.rationale: The model separates physical components from verb-noun functional bases and allocates responsibilities to the storage/delivery, transport, and control components. Textbook guidance supports these modeling choices only; invention facts and synchronization responsibility are supported by patent passage f28900d954312c449cce1af7c239ae7c and other cited patent passages, not textbook material.

summary: Revision 3 resolves the previous warning: the inferred rotation-command signal interface and associated flow are absent, while the controller's claimed synchronization responsibility remains in its description and action. I read the cited patent passages and relevant textbook modeling guidance. The remaining SJS is structurally coherent, its material interfaces are connected and type-compatible, and its components/functions are supported by patent evidence. The optional further-processing sink and minimum-two quantity assumptions are explicitly qualified rather than presented as universal fixed embodiment facts. No unresolved findings.
